name: Maha Thammaracha I
contribution: He was the first Buddhist philosopher to write in the Thai language.

checks.lead: Maha Thammaracha I (Thai: มหาธรรมราชาที่ ๑, pronounced [mā.hǎː tʰām.mā.rāː.t͡ɕʰāː tʰîː nɯ̀ŋ]), born as Li Thai (Thai: ลิไทย, pronounced [líʔ.tʰāj]), was King of Sukhothai. He was the first Buddhist philosopher to write in the Thai language. He reigned from about 1347, and the end of the reign is given as 1368 or as 1374. Li Thai was the son of Loe Thai and the grandson of Ram Khamhaeng the Great.
